## Checklist

- [ ] Tests cover the change (unit in `__tests__/src`, or Playwright in `__tests__/e2e` for hydration, streaming or cross-framework behaviour)
- [ ] A changeset is included (`npx changeset`), or the change is docs/tests only
- [ ] README and `docs/design.md` describe the new behaviour
- [ ] Any `size-limit` budget increase is explained
